'''Harido Wald''' was the largest [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling ring]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and one of the five ruling organizations on [[Mek-Sha]] by [[3627 BBY]]. The group was led by [[Veek (Rodian)|Veek the Sneak]] and constituted mostly of [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]]. The group was known to have an intense rivalry with another one of Mek-Sha's factions, the [[Dar'manda]].<ref name="The Gangs of Mek-Sha" />
